name: Sales Return Fraud Monitor
query:
SELECT
  si.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:170",
  si.name AS "Return Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:160",
    si.posting_date AS "Return Date:Date:95",
   -- si.owner AS "Return User:Data:140",
   si.grand_total AS "Return Amount:Currency:120",
   orig.grand_total AS "Original Amount:Currency:120",
   orig.posting_date AS "Original Date:Date:95",
  
  si.owner AS "Return Created By",
  si.return_against AS "Original Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:160",
  si.comment AS "Remark:Data:300",
   -- orig.owner AS "Original User:Data:140",
  
  DATEDIFF(si.posting_date, orig.posting_date) AS "Days Gap:Int:80",
  CASE
    WHEN si.return_against IS NULL OR si.return_against = '' THEN 'NO ORIGINAL'
    WHEN orig.name IS NULL THEN 'ORIGINAL MISSING'
    WHEN si.grand_total > orig.grand_total THEN 'RETURN > ORIGINAL'
    WHEN DATEDIFF(si.posting_date, orig.posting_date) > 7 THEN 'LATE RETURN'
    WHEN si.owner <> orig.owner THEN 'DIFFERENT USER'
    ELSE 'OK'
  END AS "Risk Flag:Data:140"
FROM
  `tabSales Invoice` si
LEFT JOIN
  `tabSales Invoice` orig
  ON orig.name = si.return_against
WHERE
  si.is_return = 1
  AND si.docstatus = 1
ORDER BY
  si.posting_date DESC, si.modified DESC;
